title: What accounting is

2026-11-01T08:14:01Z write: the API refused it in the chapter request, so it is written on its own next

match.reason: None of the bank points defines what accounting is: they cover the balance of payments, current and capital account flows, and ethics in financial reporting, which are narrower or unrelated topics.

draft.title: What accounting is
card: Accounting is the process of recording, reporting, analysing and advising on financial information. Owners use it to make decisions about their business.
writing down each financial event as it happens, such as a sale, a bill paid or a purchase of stock.
summing up the recorded information in reports that owners and other users can read.
studying the reports to find what they show, then explaining to the owner what it means so the owner can choose what to do.
draft.remember: Accounting turns financial events into information that helps owners decide.

a.q: Which task is an example of the accounting step called recording?
opts: Writing down each sale of a haircut on the day it happens
Explaining to the owner why profit was lower this month
Putting the month's results into a report for the owner
Telling the owner to hire a second hairdresser next year
a.why: Recording means writing down each financial event as it happens, so noting a sale on the day is recording. Putting results into a report is reporting, which comes after the events are recorded.
a.clue: Which task captures a single event as it happens?

b.q: Ravi runs a plumbing business in Bendigo. His accountant studies the year's reports, finds that van costs have grown fast, and suggests he compare leasing with buying. Which steps is the accountant carrying out?
b.why: Studying the reports to find that van costs have grown is analysing. Suggesting that Ravi compare leasing with buying is advising. The accountant is not writing down events or building the reports here, so recording and reporting are not what is described.
b.clue: The accountant is working from reports that already exist.

a.best: Writing down each sale of a haircut on the day it happens
